item.title: Playhead 0.1.0 (build 15)
item.description:
**Finding and starting sources** - The automatic pick puts healthy torrents first: more seeders and peers win, and near-dead releases are used only when nothing better is left. - While a source starts, the next two are tried alongside it. If the first delivers nothing within 8 s, playback switches to whichever already has data. The others are dropped at once. - Faster failover: a source that failed is never retried. - Choose source can sort by Recommended, Seeders, Size or Quality, and remembers your choice.
**Player** - Subtitles show on Android with both players. - Less background work while the controls are hidden (about 1 update a second instead of 4). - On narrow portrait screens the controls use two rows, so nothing gets squeezed.
**Kids profiles** - TV rows also check each show's age rating in the background; anything unconfirmed disappears.
**Polish** - Sheet titles line up with their content. - The person page is centred on phones. - The player settings sheet uses the shared corner sizes.
**Windows** - Back in sync with macOS and Android.
